messages.text:
I can’t issue the combined refund to your new MasterCard:

- Your velvet cushion was already refunded for BRL 99.90 to the order’s original payment, receipt **R-H426-0001**. It cannot be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).
- Refunds cannot be redirected to a new card; they can only go to the original payment (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Only the woven throw blanket remains available to request separately, to the original payment. Since you’ve declined that option, I haven’t created a proposal.
